title: The $6.3B Binance hack was pulled off in just 20 minutes
content: Binance suffered a major cryptocurrency hack in May 2019, resulting in the theft of approximately $567 million in digital assets. The attack was executed in under 20 minutes and involved exploiting a vulnerability in the platform's wallet system. Despite the scale of the breach, Binance stated that user funds were not affected, as the stolen assets came from the company's own reserves. The incident highlighted significant cybersecurity risks within the cryptocurrency exchange industry.

title: Why AI Could Turn Small Law Firms Into Billion-Dollar Businesses
content: Eve CEO Jay Madheswaran argues that artificial intelligence can transform small law firms by making previously unprofitable cases economically viable, thereby expanding legal access. The technology automates plaintiff law from intake to settlement, enabling attorneys to manage significantly more clients. This efficiency shifts lawyers toward high-value advocacy and may eventually lead to automated negotiations. Ultimately, drastically reducing the cost of filing cases could fundamentally alter the legal system's structure.
